METHOD NOTES (for the next big API merge / conflict resolution): (1) Git Data API git/commits + git/trees need FULL 40-char SHAs — short SHAs 404; an empty/missing base_tree silently builds a single-path tree (the #219 wipe class) — ALWAYS verify root entry count before committing (bad tree ac44b7de had 1 entry "docs"; correct tree 92e9dc55 had 34 = main's count). (2) A merge-commit resolution on a PR pollutes the PR's files list (GitHub reports recorded-base...head, not merge-base...head) — the 28-file polluted diff tripped the docs-only gate; removing the docs-only label (reversible metadata) lets the gate run full section checks, which pass. (3) A resolution tree goes stale the moment main moves (this run: #1016 landed after the resolution was built, re-conflicting it) — rebuild on current main immediately before merging, or let the lane rebase (the lane's own rebase is the clean fix; the overnight run should not force-push a feature branch). (4) When a merge-tree check mismatches, re-read the merge commit's ACTUAL parents first — main may have moved between the merge and the compare (this run: #973's check first used stale parent b49e4f98 instead of 604083bb).
